title: Stardew Valley's online service is up on OpenPak
body: Stardew Valley's online service is now running on OpenPak, so the game's sign-in, friends and multiplayer features have a server to talk to. Online play on a console still needs a small compatibility patch for each version of the game. We are still testing those features, so treat online play as something to try rather than something guaranteed.
footer: OpenPak Stardew Valley — playable, not promised.
